# Superstacks 6.3.0

Unclear assignments get plain-language questions before work starts.

This tag is for the owner to create later. This pull request does not push `v6.3.0`.

## Changes

- New model-invoked `ama` skill: look before asking, sort open points into ask, assume or look up, ask at most four questions at a time with two to four easy options each (one Recommended), record answers through `owner-decisions`, then send a short brief to confirm
- The quality and safety bar (test-first, verified, reviewed, secure by default) is stated as never up for a question
- `ama/templates/QUESTIONS.md` and `ama/scripts/check_questions.py` (sheet validator)
- `ticket-pipeline` and the README list `ama` first
